statement: Four red jars and 27 separate plant or plant-part drawings are visible across four registers. I linked the drawings to candidate ZL locus IDs by visible inscription placement and sequence, with uncertain extra loci retained separately. The two intact leafy forms are at the right of the third register and across the large fourth register.

annotation_notes: I annotated from the Beinecke image and the ZL locus headers only, without displaying any transliterated words or other annotation. All attached motifs of one drawing are grouped into a single object. I used plant_part for isolated root-like or fragment-like specimens without deciding their anatomy or species. The green area interrupting the parchment at the top register is treated as a damaged or underlying area, not as a separate drawn object. The x,y centers are approximate in the 2702 by 3765 pixel scan with top-left origin. Labels with probable matches were inferred from scan position and the transcriber's order; the indices alone do not specify pixel positions. The extra f99r.7 line follows f99r.6 in location metadata. I retain it as neighboring the same grouped area, without choosing another drawn referent. F99r.25 lies in the gap between the large fanned part and the next slender part. F99r.33 lies near the first crossed part in row three and may be a second label; both are left without primary assignments.
